scope: 性能测量口径与 requestAnimationFrame 官方定义查证
content: The window.requestAnimationFrame() method tells the browser you wish to perform an animation. It requests the browser to call a user-supplied callback function before the next repaint.
conclusion: window.requestAnimationFrame 回调发生在浏览器执行下一次重绘之前，是预重绘调度回调点，不代表物理像素已绘制完毕；测量口径应界定为重绘前调度延迟。
